test_title: PYST 51: SSC CGL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the aim of the PM Ujjwala 2.0 Yojna launched in August 2021?

options.text: Free LPG connections for commercial use
20 million LPG connections will be provided to the beneficiaries
10 million LPG connections will be provided to the beneficiaries
Free gas stove for BPL Households

solution:
The correct answer is __**10 million LPG connections will be provided to the beneficiaries**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched Ujjwala 2.0 (Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana - PMUY) by handing over LPG connections, at Mahoba, Uttar Pradesh__ on 10th August 2021.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Ujjwala 1.0 was launched in 2016 and the target was set to provide LPG connections to five crore women members of BPL households.
 
• Subsequently, the scheme was expanded in April 2018 to include women beneficiaries from seven more categories: SC/ST, PMAY, AAY, Most backward classes, tea garden, forest dwellers, Islands.
 
• In the Union budget for FY 21-22, provision for an additional one crore LPG connection under the PMUY scheme was announced.
 
• These one crore additional PMUY connections (under Ujjwala 2.0) aim to provide deposit-free LPG connections to those low-income families who could not be covered under the earlier phase of PMUY.
 
• Along with a deposit free LPG connection, Ujjwala 2.0 will provide the first refill and hotplate free of cost to the beneficiaries. Also, the enrollment procedure will require minimal paperwork.
